name: T2 Professional
summary: Booster T2 Professional edition: Booster Robotics' flagship embodied-AI development humanoid — about 1.4 m and ~42 kg (base configuration), 31 DoF (6 per leg, 7 per arm, 3 waist, 2 head), 140 Nm peak joint torque, 10 kg maximum dual-arm load (posture-dependent), 3 m/s walking speed, 48 V / 10 Ah battery for about 2 h of continuous walking, binocular head and waist cameras, optional LiDAR, wrist cameras and end effectors (grippers or dexterous hands). Compute: 'Jetson Thor T5000, 2070 TFLOPS' (manual; 'Jetson Thor T5000 (14-core Neoverse-V3AE @2.6GHz)', '2,070 TFLOPS (FP4 — sparse)', 128 GB). Sources: booster.tech and docs.booster.tech, agent-retrieved 2026-09-11.
specs_note: RETRIEVAL: AGENT_ASSISTED_RESEARCH (docs/26) — retrieved 2026-09-11 by Claude Opus 5 (curl + WebFetch) in a session initiated by Robert Konecny for European Catalogue Gap Batch 01B, under research work order 'OWNER WORK ORDER — BATCH 01B COMMERCIAL RESEARCH' (2026-09-11; docs/26 §2.1). Not a MANUAL_BOOTSTRAP reading. Not human-verified. Manufacturer sources: booster.tech/booster-t2 specification tabs and the T2 Product Manual specification page (docs.booster.tech). height_cm 140.0 ('Height (standing): ~1.4m (140cm)'); weight_kg 42.0 is the BASE-edition figure (manual: 'E1: ~42 kg; E2 (gripper): ~43 kg; E3 (dexterous hand): ~43 kg', Pro: 'P1: ~42 kg; P2 (gripper): ~43 kg; P3 (dexterous hand): ~43 kg'); degrees_of_freedom 31 (6 per leg, 7 per arm, 3 waist, 2 head); runtime_minutes 120 ('Battery Life: Continuous walking 2h'); walk_speed_ms 3.0 ('Walking Speed: 3m/s', stated on both the product page and the manual). has_vision: head and waist binocular cameras. has_sdk / has_api / ros_support / simulation_support TRUE at MEDIUM: Booster's official open-source page lists an 'SDK' ('an integration development suite used to support secondary development based on Booster robots'), a 'ROS2 SDK', 'Booster Train — Isaac Lab-based RL training framework' and 'Booster Deploy — Lightweight deployment framework (Sim2Real, Sim2Sim)'; these are platform-level, not T2-specific, statements — Generation Robots' T2 page corroborates 'Open high-level and low-level APIs', 'Native ROS 2 integration' and 'High-precision virtual simulation and sim-to-real transfer'. CONFLICTS preserved: (1) walking speed — Generation Robots: 'Up to 2 m/s'; manufacturer 3 m/s used (source priority), MEDIUM. (2) payload — manufacturer: 'Maximum Dual-Arm Payload: 10kg*' ('*The maximum arm payload varies significantly depending on arm posture'); reichelt: T2 EDU 'Horizontal payload of up to 5 kg per arm' / 'Loading capacity: 5', T2 PRO '3 kg horizontal payload per arm' / 'Loading capacity: 3'; 3Digital (IT) T2 Pro: '5 kg' per arm. payload_kg is recorded per arm elsewhere in this catalogue; the manufacturer gives only a posture-dependent dual-arm figure and the distributors disagree per edition, so payload_kg stays UNKNOWN. (3) battery_wh left UNKNOWN: Booster states 'Voltage: 48V' and 'Battery Capacity: 10Ah' but no watt-hour figure; 480 Wh would be a derived value. has_language_ui UNKNOWN: the T2 manual has a 'Voice Interaction' section that could not be retrieved (the guessed URL redirected to the Booster homepage), and the product page lists only 'Microphone array + speaker' and warning voice prompts. developer_edition UNKNOWN: both editions are presented as a 'Flagship Embodied Development Platform'. model_code NULL: reichelt part numbers 'T2_EDU' / 'T2_PRO' are seller identifiers. Compute has no catalogue field — see summary. CONFLICT (compute naming/figure): reichelt lists 'System: Nvidia Thor Orin' and '2,000 TOPS' (3Digital likewise 'Nvidia Thor Orin', '2000 TOPS'). 'Thor Orin' mixes two NVIDIA product names; Booster names the module 'Jetson Thor T5000' and states 2,070 TFLOPS (FP4, sparse). Manufacturer naming used. reichelt lists the T2 PRO at 'Weight: 43000 g' (and a separate 'Weight 55 kg').

spec_caveats.text: Not recorded. Booster states a maximum COMBINED dual-arm load of 10 kg, posture-dependent (kept as its own extended specification); reichelt claims 3 kg per arm for this edition and another reseller claims 5 kg. A combined figure is not converted into a per-arm value.

Manufacturer-stated maximum combined dual-arm load: 10 kg, posture-dependent — 'The maximum arm payload varies significantly depending on arm posture' (booster.tech/booster-t2 and the T2 product manual, observed 2026-09-11).

2,070 TFLOPS (FP4, sparse) on Jetson Thor T5000 for this edition; the Education edition states 375 TOPS (INT8). Different precisions and sparsity conditions — not directly comparable. reichelt's listing names 'Nvidia Thor Orin' at 2,000 TOPS, which mixes two NVIDIA product names.
3 m/s per Booster's own page and product manual. One reseller states up to 2 m/s.
Booster states 48 V and 10 Ah but no watt-hour figure; no value is derived here.
The T2 manual has a voice-interaction section that could not be retrieved; the product page lists only a microphone array, a speaker and voice prompts.
Both T2 editions are presented as development platforms, so this flag would not distinguish them; left unstated.
